name: DIADEMATA
confidence: high; see the note on bars 6 and 11
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (Appendix to Hymns Ancient and Modern, 1869); the opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit.
reviewNotes: High. The tune turns towards A major twice: G sharp on 'an-' (bar 6) and on 'who' (bar 11). Some books change key there instead of printing 'fe'.
